name: savepinned
description: A chrome extension to save and load groups of pinned tabs

scripts.run:chromium: tsc && node scripts/prepare-extension.mjs && web-ext run --source-dir .extension-build -t chromium --keep-profile-changes --pre-install --chromium-profile savepinned-profile-chromium -v
scripts.run:firefox: tsc && node scripts/prepare-extension.mjs && web-ext run --source-dir .extension-build -t firefox-desktop --keep-profile-changes --pre-install --firefox-profile savepinned-profile-firefox -v --bc
scripts.run:firefox-mac: tsc && node scripts/prepare-extension.mjs && web-ext run --source-dir .extension-build -t firefox-desktop --firefox-binary=/Applications/Firefox\ Developer\ Edition.app/Contents/MacOS/firefox-bin --keep-profile-changes --pre-install --firefox-profile savepinned-profile-firefox -v --bc
scripts.run:brave: tsc && node scripts/prepare-extension.mjs && web-ext run --source-dir .extension-build -t chromium --chromium-binary=brave-browser --keep-profile-changes --pre-install --chromium-profile savepinned-profile-brave
scripts.run:vivaldi: tsc && node scripts/prepare-extension.mjs && web-ext run --source-dir .extension-build -t chromium --chromium-binary=vivaldi --keep-profile-changes --pre-install --chromium-profile savepinned-profile-vivaldi
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:firefox
